cohort: Women with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) in France
finding: More than half the cases of PAS occurred in women without the combination of placenta praevia and a prior caesarean delivery, and these women had better maternal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) who did not have both placenta previa and a prior cesarean delivery had better maternal and neonatal outcomes compared to those who did.
